text: Thanks for making time, Jonah. I want to settle the renewal before the contract rolls on October 1.
We're planning to renew. The open question is whether we add the warehouse seats or stay at twenty-four.
Usage says that team is sharing logins. They're the group that would actually feel eight more seats.
If we add eight, I need this year's rate held. I'm not taking a surprise uplift into finance.
I can hold the rate if we sign before Friday. After that the new price list applies.
Friday works if legal has the DPA back. They flagged the subprocessors list last week.
I'll send the updated subprocessors today and stay on the thread with your counsel.
The other gate is the security questionnaire. Our insurer asked for it before they'll sign off.
I have last quarter's answers. I'll refresh retention and send them tomorrow morning.
Retention is the section they'll read. We need meeting video deleted at twelve months, not kept indefinitely.
That's already the default on your workspace. I'll point them at the setting so nobody has to hunt.
Then my decision is we renew, we add eight seats, and we don't announce it internally until the DPA is countersigned.
I'll draft the order form for thirty-two seats at the current rate and send it with the DPA tonight.
Copy Amira in finance. She'll block time to sign if the papers are clean.
